text: The Patriots suffered a stinging Week 3 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars, who showcased their offensive firepower with Trevor Lawrence tossing three touchdown passes—including a spectacular fingertip grab by Parker Washington in the end zone—in a performance that only deepened questions about rookie quarterback Drake Maye's early struggles. Without tight end Eli Raridon (thigh) and safety Craig Woodson (shoulder), the Patriots' defense will lean heavily on second-round linebacker Gabe Jacas, who has already made impact plays in his first two weeks and will start again against Jacksonville. Beyond the personnel challenges, the Patriots face a growing concern about situational football, with coaches acknowledging they need significant improvement in clock management before halftime after two consecutive games marred by questionable late-second-quarter decisions. The Jaguars, coming off their worst offensive performance in eleven months, clearly found their rhythm against New England, while the Patriots continue the difficult process of figuring out who they are as a team.
